```python
import re
import sys

values = {}

for instruction in sys.stdin.read().split(";"):
    instruction = instruction.strip()
    if not instruction:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\d+)", instruction)
    if match:
        name, number = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(number)
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)",
        instruction,
    )
    if match:
        name, source, increment, modulus = match.groups()
        values[name] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)
        continue

    raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized instruction: {instruction}")

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in "abcdefgh") +
      f"; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
```
